theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) (r : ℝ) (K : Set (Euclid P)), Orthonormal ℝ g → IsCompact K → K ⊆ ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ : Set (Euclid P)) → IsCompact {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r} ∧ IsCompact (Set.image2 (fun t y => t + y) {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r} K) ∧ Set.image2 (fun t y => t + y) {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r} K ⊆ {x | ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) x| ≤ r} ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' K
